questions.question: Explain two reasons why Muslims fast during Ramadan.

points.text: 1) Self-discipline and taqwa — fasting teaches Muslims to control their physical desires and focus on spiritual matters. By resisting the urge to eat and drink, Muslims strengthen their willpower and their devotion to Allah. 2) Empathy with the poor — experiencing hunger during daylight hours helps Muslims understand the daily suffering of those who do not have enough food.
